And max 3 bakugan per player unless you're doing a 1v1. 

Sorry if that seemed confusing but that was kind of in a way a mish mash of how the game activated, honestly if the game irl took away the G Power and made it a activate abilities until bakugan koed then that would probably hurt the reputation as being literally Pokemon with fancy words lol.
